title: Dave Tough
summary: DeMichael named his son after Catlett and Tough; Saunders remembers Dave's drinking, a hotel mattress fire, and his feather touch.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah. You know, I named my son after Sid Catlett.
I named my son after Sid Catlett and Dave Tough.
Yeah, right, right. And David was a very close friend of mine.

Well, Dave, he loved his whisky. And then he would just get out of it. And at one time, I was living down to the Venetian Hotel, and -- that was at 36 and And then Dave came in and he rented a room with a girl, and they were there. And he set -- the mattress set afire, because he was just ossified. So -- and they burned up all the mattresses and they had the Fire Department men in there, everything going.
But he was a very, very meek and very meek guy, and very timid.
I met him one time when Woody Herman's band played Louisville.
Right. And he loved colored women. His wife was colored. And so they -- that was his thing. But his whisky, I think, was his biggest setback, yeah, and he was
another one with one of those beautiful touches. I used to love that. I mean, he had that same feather touch, a little bit -- a little bitty guy, weighed 90 pounds soaking wet, almost, about 100 --
